'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Todd Benard DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Todd Benard]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Todd Bernard
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
